user.title: Add a Shutters Dongle
user.description: Dongles on the same network are usually found automatically. To add one by hand, enter its IP address and the password of its web interface.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Shutters Dongle found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add **{name}** ({host})? Enter the password of its web interface.

reauth_confirm.title: Password changed
reauth_confirm.description: {name} ({host}) no longer accepts the saved password. Enter the current web interface password.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the dongle at this address.
error.password_not_set: The dongle is still on its first-start password. Open its web interface and set a password first.
error.rate_limited: The dongle is refusing logins for a moment after a failed attempt. Try again.
error.firmware_too_old: Update the dongle's firmware from its web interface: System → Firmware update.

abort.already_configured: This dongle is already set up.
